description: This file is a shell script for testing various features and behaviors of the 'git clone' command, especially focusing on the '-c' configuration option and related behaviors during cloning, such as setting config variables, handling shallow repositories, and remote fetch settings.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in input and expects a match.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to output for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_path_is_hidden
methods.description: Checks whether a specified path is hidden.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test script execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to execute when the current test finishes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for differences.
